name: Tablet Shard
summary: The Tablet Shard comes from an ancient troll tablet beneath the Vile Reef. Kin'weelay seeks it for a sacred place in Orgrimmar, where it can honor the Darkspear hero Gri'lek.

sections.title: A Fragment of Gri'lek
sections.body: Beneath the waters of the Savage Coast, the Tablet Shard is taken from a tablet bearing the tale of Gri'lek the Wanderer. Kin'weelay wants a fragment for the Darkspear tribe's new home in Orgrimmar. There, it will remind the tribe of Gri'lek's might and honor.

faq.answer: The Tablet Shard is a fragment of an ancient troll tablet beneath the Vile Reef. It bears the tale of Gri'lek the Wanderer.

aliases: who do I give it to
faq.answer: Kin'weelay at Grom'gol Base Camp wants the Tablet Shard for a sacred place in Orgrimmar.

faq.q: Why does the Darkspear tribe want it?
faq.answer: The shard will honor Gri'lek the Wanderer and remind the Darkspear tribe of his might and honor.
The tablet lies beneath the waters of the Savage Coast, in the ruins known as the Vile Reef.

angles.text: As a troll, the Tablet Shard carries the sacred tale of Gri'lek, a hero of troll legends, and is meant to honor him among the Darkspear.
The Darkspear tribe seeks the Tablet Shard for a sacred place in its new home in Orgrimmar.
